--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}

  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);

--- source ---

  // Fog fades geometry toward the fog color with eye-space distance.
  // glFogi picks the equation: GL_EXP2 (used here) and GL_EXP fall off
  // exponentially with GL_FOG_DENSITY; GL_LINEAR instead ramps between
  // glFogf(GL_FOG_START, ...) and glFogf(GL_FOG_END, ...) distances.
  // Matching GL_FOG_COLOR to glClearColor makes far rings dissolve into
  // the background, which is what hides each ring's respawn at the far
  // end of this endless tunnel. Drag `density` to thicken or clear it.
  // The tunnel snakes: each ring's center sits on a fixed curve
  // (bendX, bendY) of its depth ringZ, and the ring is yawed/pitched to
  // face along the curve's tangent, so rings sweep around the bends as
  // they approach. Drag `twist` to straighten or sharpen the curve.
  static float density = 0.055; // @tune
  static float twist = 1.2; // @tune
  static float ringZ; // eye-space distance of the current ring
  static float bendX; // tunnel centerline x at this depth
  static float bendY; // tunnel centerline y at this depth

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_FOG);
  glFogi(GL_FOG_MODE, GL_EXP2);
  glFogfv(GL_FOG_COLOR, (GLfloat[]){0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1});
  glFogf(GL_FOG_DENSITY, density);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);

  for(i, 0, 12) {
    ringZ = 37 - fmod(3 * t + 3 * i, 37);
    bendX = twist * sin(0.24 * ringZ);
    bendY = 0.7 * twist * (cos(0.31 * ringZ) - 1);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(bendX, bendY, 0 - ringZ);
      glRotatef(0 - 14 * twist * cos(0.24 * ringZ), 0, 1, 0);
      glRotatef(0 - 12 * twist * sin(0.31 * ringZ), 1, 0, 0);
      glRotatef(8 * ringZ, 0, 0, 1);
      if(fmod(i, 3) < 1) {
        glColor3f(0.1, 0.95, 0.85);
      } else if(fmod(i, 3) < 2) {
        glColor3f(0.15, 0.55, 1);
      } else {
        glColor3f(0.95, 0.25, 1);
      }
      glutSolidTorus(0.09, 1.7, 10, 28);
    glPopMatrix();
  }
